en: The image depicts a bustling open-air market scene with many people, likely vendors and shoppers, filling a wide area. The background includes some classical-style buildings and a large structure with columns, typical of southern European or Mediterranean architecture. The image is in black and white, suggesting it is historical. There is printed text along the right edge in several languages, including French and Greek, and a watermark with a Greek website.
